purpose: Define a read-only Expose monitor for crypto profiles, handshakes, rekey state, integrity failures, remote authority results and network security audit evidence.

topics.name: Network Security Monitor
topics.purpose: Define a read-only Expose monitor for crypto profiles, handshakes, rekey state, integrity failures, remote authority results and network security audit evidence.

semantics.identity_rule: Peer, connection, session, handshake, key ref, authorization decision and audit identities remain distinct.
semantics.secret_rule: Raw private/session key material is structurally excluded.
semantics.authority_rule: Viewing security state grants no network/admin authority.

invariants.rule: Listener, route, endpoint, connection, channel, peer reachability and cryptographic transport evidence never by themselves grant application, data or operation authority.
Inbound network data remains inert until explicit protocol parsing, validation, identity/context resolution, authorization and dispatcher routing succeed.

references.purpose: Monitor surfaces fail-closed network security failures.
